decisions: T024, T033, and T026 are accepted CLEO dependencies with status done and all verification gates passed, so T052 implementation semantics permit proceeding.
OptionChainSelector consumes T024 ContractRecord and ContractRepository values and T026 OptionSelection settings without creating a provider or Azure client.
Nearest expiration dates are selected after excluding contracts expired or inactive on the selection date; strike bounds are inclusive and calculated from Decimal spot values.
DailyFrontSet freezes and deterministically sorts OSI membership, while InMemoryDailyFrontSetRepository replaces duplicate underlying/date keys for reproducible reruns.
ContractsCatalog exposes T024 contract queries together with daily front-set persistence and underlying/date filtering.
limitations: No live Alpaca/provider calls, credentials, network access, Azure provisioning, or live Azure calls were used.
The shared worktree contains concurrent task changes; only the queue-worker test harness yield and its type-safe catch-up test annotation were corrected during integrated verification.
No MyPy run was performed; repository tooling uses Ruff and ty.
